stay_w1_order_policy.distance: 3D Euclidean native position; descending; deterministic ascending native-key ties

stay_w1_order_policy.native_order: scheduled w1 first when w0 did not fall back and that point is untried; remaining retries far-to-near from actual w0
stay_w1_order_policy.native_origin: actual physically settled w0 anchor metadata.position, including successful native fallback
stay_w1_order_policy.unchanged: native tokens, pool membership/caps, Flip sequence, Stay A/B alternation, Look/Direct alternation, seed0, all acceptance thresholds

bbox_proposal_rank_policy.deadline: optional original soft-deadline callback before each point; exceptions propagate before any returned ranked pool, without mutating the input
bbox_proposal_rank_policy.domain: retain every original entry and native token, including unknown or low-ranked predictions; no eligibility filter or cap
bbox_proposal_rank_policy.geometry: original anchor world-axis AABB size translated to the existing projected proposal centre; no new placement coordinates
bbox_proposal_rank_policy.one_step_area: maximum clipped projected rectangle area among supplied existing one-action cameras; not mask/evidence pixels or action availability
bbox_proposal_rank_policy.ordering: known start and one-step prediction first, predicted whole-box outside first, larger one-step rectangle area, larger signed starting margin, original input order

bbox_proposal_rank_policy.scope: proposal prediction only; no acceptance result or measured visibility is produced
bbox_proposal_rank_policy.start_margin: signed rectangle separation from the starting frame; positive means the entire predicted rectangle is outside
bbox_proposal_rank_policy.unchanged: all actual physical, target, mask, RGB, evidence and witness checks; side/seed assignment, counters and schedules

discovery_schedule_policy.exhaustion: StopIteration, seen proposal, native failure, and ten consecutive physical rejections consume a domain visit; other round domains still proceed
discovery_schedule_policy.native_queries: unchanged native discovery and original authenticated queries; no cached or inferred coordinates
discovery_schedule_policy.round: discover at most one new combination, then process each combination active at that round start once
discovery_schedule_policy.scope: search scheduling only; fewer discoveries per active round, no speedup or acceptance claim
discovery_schedule_policy.unchanged: all domain contents, seed0 assignment, global counted attempt IDs, seen set, safe native retries, native failure counting, physical10-skip, thresholds and cleanup

fixed_label_policy.visible_subset: draw only currently visible declared candidates; never renumber a subset

flip_geometry_policy.distance: full3D Euclidean distance from predicted anchor centre to candidate metadata.position; near<far and far>=1.5*near

flip_geometry_policy.input_domain: all original native query tokens before horizontal, screen-side, or native-surface-point distance-ratio pruning
flip_geometry_policy.one_step: each world independently has a supplied existing one-action camera with a known bbox and strictly positive clipped rectangle area; actions may differ
flip_geometry_policy.prefix: all8 projected original anchor AABB corners known in front of camera; whole predicted rectangle outside v0 by at least10 pixels
flip_geometry_policy.scope: proposal geometry only; no measured mask pixels, physical validity or scientific acceptance claim

flip_geometry_policy.stay: original historical Stay domain, ordering, schedule, retry rules and scientific validation untouched
flip_geometry_policy.storage: all prefilter input occurrences/reasons retained as compact native query references; complete coordinates stay in original native-query evidence
flip_geometry_policy.unknown: unknown projection/geometry never counts as a passing prediction

flip_search_policy.domain: all queried native points separated by3D distance ratio1.5,10px-outside,one-step-projection and3m filters; no old horizontal-side, proximity, overlap-proposal or12-point cap for Flip
flip_search_policy.flip_order: native3D near/far ratio, then stable native key; actual settled3D acceptance remains mandatory
flip_search_policy.identities: opposite-edge candidate pairs first, then original same-category/name order
flip_search_policy.no_flip_domain: continue other combinations/views; never fill a required Flip turn with Stay
flip_search_policy.prediction: native selected coordinate is only proposal geometry; PlaceObjectAtPoint resolves its own surface and pivot, so actual settled metadata is authoritative
flip_search_policy.quota: across the entire scene, including Controller restarts: counted Flip attempts >= counted Stay attempts; failed native placement does not earn quota
flip_search_policy.receptacles: all original eligible scene receptacles in deterministic original order
flip_search_policy.stay: original first12 near points per side and supplement11 far-first retries
flip_search_policy.unchanged: seed0 world-side assignment, StayA/B alternation, physical10-rejection skip, all acceptance thresholds
flip_search_policy.views: existing allowed views reordered toward actual-geometric candidate centres at opposite left/right image edges; actual native visibility still required

restoration.scope: state restore: all movable/pickupable positions <=1cm and exact full agent pose; RGB separate

spawn_token_storage_policy.coordinates: one detached read-only JSON-equivalent coordinate tree per actual query; deepcopy shares only that tree
spawn_token_storage_policy.deadline: original simulator soft deadline checked before query, during coordinate copy and before each point validation/registration
spawn_token_storage_policy.native_query: same GetSpawnCoordinatesAboveReceptacle(objectId, anywhere=True), complete original actionReturn in original order
spawn_token_storage_policy.registration: every original token is registered before return with exactly SHA256(engine.encoded(token)); hash common canonical prefix once then copy hash state per selected point
spawn_token_storage_policy.scope: representation and CPU work only; no native domain, ordering, seed, physics, pixel, target or witness threshold changes
spawn_token_storage_policy.use_validation: unchanged validate_spawn and fresh complete-token SHA256 registry membership at actual placement; no cached caller-token digest
